title: A stack separated over the base has separated diagonal and consequently separated structure morphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an algebraic stack separated over a base has diagonals with the corresponding separation property and hence a separated structure morphism (author lemma at source lines 1060-1085, label lemma-separated-implies-morphism-separated). The proof (source lines 1087-1114) identifies the diagonal of the structure morphism with the diagonal of the stack over the base, transfers the separation property using stability under base change and reads it as separatedness of the structure morphism (proof lines 1087-1113). The identification of the two diagonals is the substance. H3.
